prompt: A factory operates with 3 identical production lines. Each line can produce 25 units per hour. The factory runs for 10 hours a day, 5 days a week. The raw material cost per unit is $12. In addition, there is a fixed weekly overhead of $1500. Due to market demand, 8% of the total units produced are sold at a discounted price of $20 each, while the remaining units are sold at the full price of $30 each. Calculate the factory's net profit in dollars for a single week.
